golden.body: Hi, I paid my March postpaid bill of ₹1,299 via UPI on 3 March (UTR: 409812334567), but I was charged again on 8 March for the same invoice INV-MAR-784512. My account is ACC-784512, mobile 98765 43210. Please reverse the duplicate charge and confirm the refund timeline. I have attached the payment screenshot in my previous mail to billing@.

golden.subject: FINAL WARNING — raising TRAI complaint and closing account if not resolved today
golden.body: This is unacceptable. I have raised the same billing and service issue THREE times (tickets #T-44102, #T-44891) with no callback. Your agent promised a refund last week and nothing happened. I am a 6-year customer (ACC-556701) and I will file a TRAI complaint and port out to a competitor TODAY unless a team lead calls me back and fixes this. I also want compensation for the harassment. Do not send another template reply.
